headline: Nations League: Spain host England in winner-take-all Group A3 decider in Madrid
teaser: European champions Spain need only a point at the Metropolitano to lock up first place in Group A3, while Thomas Tuchel's England require an away triumph to claim top seeding.
story:
European champions Spain welcome England to the Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid on Sunday night, 15 November, for the decisive Matchday 6 showdown in UEFA Nations League Group A3.

Spain enter atop the group with 13 points, having won four and drawn one of their five fixtures, including a 2-0 win over Czechia on Thursday. England, revitalized under manager Thomas Tuchel, sit on 12 points following their 2-1 victory over Croatia at Wembley, where Harry Kane converted a decisive penalty on his record-extending 126th cap.

A draw secures first place and seeded quarter-final status for Luis de la Fuente's side, while England must secure a rare away win in Madrid to leapfrog the hosts in front of 68,000 supporters.
whyCareReason: The rematch of the Euro 2024 final decides top seed in UEFA Nations League Group A3 with global football supremacy on the line.
stakes: First place in Group A3 earns home advantage in the two-legged quarter-finals in March 2027.
rivalryAngle: Rematch of the Euro 2024 final in Berlin where Mikel Oyarzabal struck late to deny England their first major trophy since 1966.
funFacts: Harry Kane scored his 72nd international goal on his 126th cap against Croatia on Thursday.
Spain have not lost a competitive fixture on home soil in over four years.
Thomas Tuchel is managing his first official away fixture in Spain since taking over the England post.

keyPlayers.name: Harry Kane
keyPlayers.hook: Captained England to victory over Croatia with a clinical second-half penalty.
